name: Eila Compatibility Patches
description:
Compatibility patches for Eila.

Supported mods:
• asylum-town
• cathedral-town
• cetatea-town
• courtyard-town
• grove
• hota.bulwark
• hota.cove
• hota.factory
• new-pavilion
• preserve-town
• refugee-town
• retreat-town
• ruins-town
• tartarus-town
• third-upgrades (Castle / Rampart / Tower second upgrades)

You can safely enable any number of sub-patches at the same time.
author: Kay
